subject: Numerical test information in a GRM model in mirt

messages.author: 5ddfe566330663b8
messages.subject: Numerical test information in a GRM model in mirt
parts:
The ltm package provides a simple method to obtain numerical test information in a GRM model, as follows:

information(model, c(-4, 4))

as well as for specific items in the model.  Is there a similar code in mirt?

Robert Semel

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Numerical test information in a GRM model in mirt
parts:
There are functions such as iteminfo() and testinfo() in mirt for item and test information.

Phil
